findings.old: [UNCLEAR: the wording describing their arrival and the location of Ibrāhīm ibn Jārūḥ is disrupted.] They found Ibrāhīm ibn Jārūḥ, who had fainted.
findings.new: For when they came to it [UNCLEAR: the destination antecedent and the following location wording are unclear], they found Ibrāhīm ibn Jārūḥ, who had fainted.
findings.reason: Source line 8 فإنهم لما أتوا إليها وجدوا عليها بها إبراهيم بن جاروح وقد أغمى عليه contains the recoverable temporal/action clause لما أتوا إليها (when they came to it/her). The current marker describes a problem with their arrival but never translates that action or its temporal relation to finding Ibrāhīm. Preserve the readable clause and confine uncertainty to the unresolved destination antecedent and disrupted locative عليها بها; do not invent a destination.

findings.new: Sebab, ketika mereka mendatanginya [UNCLEAR: rujukan tujuan kedatangan dan redaksi lokasi sesudahnya tidak jelas], mereka mendapati Ibrāhīm bin Jārūḥ dalam keadaan pingsan.
findings.reason: Source line 8 فإنهم لما أتوا إليها clearly retains the action of coming to an unresolved destination and the temporal relation ketika; only the destination antecedent and following locative وجدوا عليها بها are disrupted. The present Indonesian marker replaces this readable clause with metacommentary. Restore the action without guessing what -nya denotes, in parity with English.
